summary: Backpressure honored. Beta independently challenged the newest eligible unprocessed b03 work item rather than opening fresh names. TER remains structurally exposed to semiconductor-test customer concentration and robotics execution, but current primary-source evidence does not create a new structural blocker; the remaining open gate is Alpha-owned governance/equity-compensation normalization.

claims.claim: Teradyne is structurally coupled to AI/advanced semiconductor compute through Semiconductor Test, where a small number of specifying and purchasing customers can drive a material share of consolidated revenue.

2025 concentration was material: two specifying customers drove 12% and 10% of consolidated revenue and one direct purchasing customer accounted for 19%, making customer demand a real resilience/falsification edge rather than a diversified-demand assumption.

Robotics remains a separate execution branch: prior primary filings described macro pressure, leadership change and a loss while management pursued a direct-customer/channel transformation; this weakens any causal thesis that assumes robotics automatically diversifies semiconductor cyclicality.

causalEdges: AI/advanced-compute demand -> semiconductor complexity -> test intensity -> TER Semiconductor Test demand
customer concentration -> purchasing/specifying decisions -> TER revenue volatility
industrial automation demand -> robotics channel execution -> diversification benefit
falsifiers: Major specifying/direct customer reduces TER platform selection or purchases without offsetting wins.
Test intensity per advanced device fails to rise enough to offset semiconductor cyclicality or competitive substitution.
Robotics channel transformation fails to restore sustainable profitability, invalidating diversification assumptions.
risks: Customer concentration can amplify cyclicality and platform-loss risk.
Robotics is not presently safe to model as a fully independent stabilizer.
unknowns: Future customer mix and platform-selection persistence are unknown and non-gating until new evidence changes the current structural map.

satisfied: explicit causal edges and falsifiers recorded
